paragraphs.source_en: The Product Manager 45 This means knowing who your various stakeholders are and especially learning the constraints they operate under. There are usually key stakeholders representing general management, sales, marketing, finance, legal, business development, and customer service. Your CEO is usually a very important stakeholder as well. Succeeding in the job of product means convincing each key stakeholder that you understand their constraints and that you are committed to only delivering solutions that you believe are consistent with those constraints. Deep Knowledge of Your Market and Industry The fourth critical contribution is deep knowledge of the market and industry in which you’re competing.
